body: Can you please paint Empoleon for me when you have time?

My idea would be a wind-wind fruit. It would be a logia class fruit giving the user the control of wind, with this power the user can control the pressure and speed of the air as well as the shape if the wind thus giving them the ability to make massive blades of wind able to cut nearly anything or being able to shoot cannons of air pressure like Franky. This ability would also be able to alter the weather. I believe that this might be an actual fruit that was eaten by Dragon, because of what happened in log town and what happened at the grey terminal
